description:
One wheat line's phenotypes across T3/Wheat trials: per trait (T3 variable) the number of trials, mean value,
mean percent of the trial mean and the years and locations. germplasm: the T3 line name (case-insensitive, e.g.
'Jagger', 'Everest', 'KS070736K-1'); trait: words to keep only matching variables. Use t3_find_studies for the
trial list and brapi_observations for plot-level values in one trial.
name: t3_line_traits
